R101.note: Injects IAuthorizationService and fails closed before delete; relies on an 'AdminOnly' policy not defined in this file, disclosed as needing Program.cs setup.

R102.note: path.basename() strips traversal/absolute-path components before the require, closing the vector without changing behavior for legitimate plugin names.

R103.note: Switching GET to POST alone leaves CSRF open (no anti-forgery token added; claim that MVC controllers get implicit token validation is incorrect), and the write-up falsely claims the confirm-page UX is unchanged when the case's own comments show it was a GET link, not a form submission, so the flow silently breaks.

R104.note: Adds requireRole('admin') matching the exact middleware chain used by sibling admin routes; no other change.

R105.note: Adds an ownership check (AuthorUserId vs caller) before delete, reusing the same identity-extraction pattern already used in SendMessage; fails closed via HubException.

R106.note: Replaces the shell call with archive/tar, closing the injection and preserving the stated text/plain output and error-status contract, but silently drops the stated 'continues using the request context for cancellation' - ctx is now an unused parameter, not mentioned in the write-up.

R107.note: Derives the stored extension from the file-type-detected MIME instead of the client-supplied originalname, matching the existing ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES check; no other behavior change.

R108.note: Removes the shell/PowerShell invocation entirely in favor of System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping, eliminating the injection surface while openly approximating the original text output shape.

R109.note: Replaces ECB with AESGCM plus a random nonce per encryption; the necessary nonce-prepended output format change is stated plainly and is required for the mode to function.

R110.note: Standard @Lazy self-injection pattern routes the call through the AOP proxy so the pre-existing @PreAuthorize('ADMIN') is actually enforced; this is the annotation's already-declared contract, not a new restriction.

R111.note: Replaces the setTimeout string-eval with an arrow-function closure carrying reminderId/message as values, not parsed text; behavior otherwise unchanged.

R112.note: Uses Express/send's built-in root option on sendFile, the documented boundary-enforcing mechanism for this exact sink; no other behavior change.

R113.note: Replaces exec() with execFile() and an argument array, removing shell interpretation of the domain string entirely; preserves the same response shape.

R114.note: Adds an account-ownership comparison against the server-loaded invoice and returns 404 uniformly for not-found and not-owned, matching the stated contract exactly.

R115.note: @EnableMethodSecurity correctly fixes the reported issue on its own; the added canManageUser() resource check is unnecessary scope creep whose docstring claims ownership/resource-level enforcement but the method ignores the authenticatedUsername argument and only checks existence, changing error behavior for a missing-user id without disclosure.
